'''Ng'ok''', commonly known as '''Ng'ok war beasts''', were foul-tempered creatures and were usually accompanied by an awful smell. They were equipped with two razor-sharp retractable claws and a tiny lashing tail. They were commonly used in many [[Star system/Legends|systems]] by owners to guard and to frighten off potential attackers.<ref name="card">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Ng'ok}}</ref>

Ng'ok were represented as a [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonster]] playing piece in the game of [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]]. A [[Ng'ok (speeder)|Sith speeder]] was named after the Ng'ok.
